summary: Manulife Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) to announce a quarterly dividend of $0.38827 per share declared on June 29, 2026. The dividend is payable on or about July 22, 2026 to shareholders of record as of June 26, 2026. Payment is in cash or via the fund's dividend reinvestment plan. This is a routine dividend declaration — not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other event is involved. The filing lacks any strategic review, forced management change, or deal negotiation.
